name: data.gov.my Open API (Data Catalogue, OpenDOSM, transport)

provider.name: Government of Malaysia (Department of Statistics Malaysia / MAMPU, data.gov.my)

summary: Keyless REST API for Malaysian open data: data catalogue tables, OpenDOSM statistics, weather and GTFS transport feeds.
description: api.data.gov.my serves catalogue tables by id (fuel prices, for example), OpenDOSM national statistics, weather forecasts and warnings, and GTFS static and realtime transit data. Filtering uses a documented query syntax (filter, ifilter, contains, range, sort, limit, include, exclude).

rate_limit.summary: 4 requests per minute per API (data catalogue, OpenDOSM, weather, GTFS) per the rate-limit docs; 429 when exceeded.

endpoints.summary: Rows of a catalogue dataset (id required)

agent_notes: The dataset id for each catalogue table is shown in the 'Sample OpenAPI query' section of its page on data.gov.my. A response is a bare JSON array, not an envelope. Use a trailing slash (/data-catalogue/) to avoid a redirect from /data-catalogue.
caveats: 4 requests per minute is very low; cache and avoid loops.
Without the trailing slash the data-catalogue path answers 301 first.
The CC BY 4.0 notice was read from the docs site footer; confirm per dataset on data.gov.my.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key.
